how: the documented shape of GET https://huggingface.co/api/whoami-v2 (Bearer), taken from Hugging Face's own client types (github.com/huggingface/huggingface.js packages/hub/src/lib/who-am-i.ts: WhoAmIUser, WhoAmIOrg, AuthInfo) — NOT a live capture: the Hub refused every Hugging Face credential stored on the recording Mac (HTTP 401), so the byte-for-byte live answer is deferred; strings here are fixture values

fieldMeaning.canPay: a payment method is on file (the read-billing OAuth scope's stated meaning; whether the openid profile inference-api scope receives it is unverified)
fieldMeaning.periodEnd: unix seconds; the billing period end (null for a free user)
fieldMeaning.creditsUsed: NOT stated anywhere on whoami-v2; no billing or usage endpoint is documented under /api (the paths /api/billing/usage, /api/settings/billing, /api/settings/billing/usage, /api/settings/billing/credits, /api/settings/usage, /api/inference-providers/usage, /api/settings/inference-providers/usage, /api/settings/inference-providers/overview, /api/me/billing, /api/users/me/billing, /api/credits/… answered 404 on 2026-09-30; huggingface.co/settings/billing and /settings/inference-providers/overview are the documented views)
